visualCharacteristics.purpose: full-width promotional banner slider; each slide is a linked banner image with its copy baked into the artwork, with prev/next arrows, dot pagination and autoplay
notes: Full-width rounded image banner slider with arrows and dot pagination; text baked into artwork.
Full-width rounded promo banner slider (14 slides, desktop + mobile images, prev/next arrows, dot pagination). Each slide is a linked image with the copy baked into the artwork.

contentPattern.structure: one row per slide; cell 1: desktop banner image, optionally followed by a mobile banner image (first picture = desktop, second = mobile); cell 2: the slide link (or optional heading, text and CTA when the copy is not baked into the image)
cells: Text content (optional: heading, description, CTA link)
reasons: Interactive rotating slider of image slides: Carousel. Text is part of the banner artwork, so each row holds the image (desktop, mobile) plus link.

reuseGuidance: Reuse carousel-hero wherever the same pattern appears (s1 (Hero banner carousel): 14 linked promotional banner slides (desktop and mobile image per slide)). Section styles seen: none.
